ko.title: 학자금 대출 리셋: 새로운 상환 규칙이 오늘날의 대출자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: 연방 학자금 대출이 수년 만에 가장 큰 전면 개편을 거치고 있습니다.

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: 2025년 7월에 서명된 법안(흔히 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act'라고 불림)은 신규 및 기존 대출의 상환 방식을 바꾸며, 학생과 부모가 빌릴 수 있는 한도도 변경합니다.

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: 이 설명서는 핵심 포인트를 요약하고, 변경되는 부분과 유지되는 부분을 구분하며, 확인해야 할 주요 날짜 목록을 제공합니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적이며 재정적 또는 법적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: 프로그램 세부 사항은 의회 및 미국 교육부에 의해 업데이트될 수 있으므로, StudentAid.gov 또는 대출 관리 기관(servicer)을 통해 구체적인 내용을 확인하세요.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 요약본

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - 새로운 소득 연계 상환 옵션인 **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**이 2026년 7월 1일 이후 실행되는 신규 대출에 대해 기존의 여러 구형 플랜을 대체합니다.

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - 신규 대출자에 대한 **Graduate PLUS 대출이 종료**되며, 대학원, 전문대학원 및 Parent PLUS 대출에 새로운 연간 및 생애 한도가 적용됩니다.

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - 현재의 많은 대출자는 당분간 기존 플랜을 유지하지만, 일부 플랜은 단계적으로 폐지되고 있으며 마감 시한이 적용됩니다.

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## 변경되는 내용

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. 새로운 상환 시스템

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: 2026년 7월 1일부터 신규 대출을 받는 대출자는 다음 두 가지 옵션 중 하나를 선택합니다:

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **구간별 표준 플랜(tiered standard plan)**: 대출 금액에 따라 결정되는 기간 동안 고정 금액을 상환합니다.

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**: 소득에 기반한 플랜입니다.

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: RAP 하에서 월 상환액은 조정후총소득(AGI)을 기준으로 하며, 일반적으로 소득의 약 1%에서 10% 사이이고 최소 상환액은 월 $10입니다.

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: 부양 자녀 1명당 상환액이 감면됩니다.

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: 대출 잔액이 늘어나는 것을 방지하기 위한 두 가지 기능이 포함되어 있습니다: 월 상환액이 월 이자를 다 감당하지 못하더라도 미납 이자가 원금에 더해지지 않으며, 제때 상환할 때마다 정부가 원금 탕감액의 일부(최대 $50)를 매칭하여 지원합니다.

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: 자격을 충족하는 상환을 30년 동안 이행한 후 남아 있는 잔액은 탕감됩니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. 구형 소득 연계 플랜의 단계적 폐지

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: SAVE, PAYE 및 ICR 플랜은 새 법안에 따라 순차적으로 종료되며, 해당 플랜 이용자는 **2028년 7월 1일**까지 RAP 또는 소득 기반 상환(IBR)과 같은 다른 플랜으로 전환해야 합니다.

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: SAVE 플랜은 법원 소송에 얽혀 있어 많은 SAVE 대출자가 일시 정지 상태에 놓여 있었습니다.

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: 이 경우에 해당한다면 대출 관리 기관의 안내를 주의 깊게 살피고, 현재의 정지 상태가 영구적이라고 가정하지 마세요.

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. 대학원 및 전문대학원 대출 한도

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: 2026년 7월 1일 이후 신규 대출자 대상:

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | 대출 유형 | 연간 한도 | 누적 한도 |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
| Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
| Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | 대학원 및 전문대학원 과정 통합 생애 한도 | | $257,500 (학부 대출 제외) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Grad PLUS 대출은 신규 대출자에게 더 이상 제공되지 않습니다.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: 한도를 초과하는 금액이 필요한 학생은 저축, 장학금, 고용주 지원금 또는 민간 대출(소득 연계 상환과 같은 연방 보호 조치가 일반적으로 제공되지 않음)에 의존해야 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. Parent PLUS 한도

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: 신규 Parent PLUS 대출은 **부양 학생 1인당 연간 $20,000, 총액 $65,000**로 제한됩니다.

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: 이미 Parent PLUS 대출(특히 통합 대출)을 보유하고 있는 부모는 자신에게 어떤 상환 옵션이 계속 제공되는지 확인해야 합니다.

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: 일반적으로 특정 통합 Parent PLUS 대출이 소득 연계 옵션을 계속 이용하려면 특정 통합 및 등록 마감 시한을 준수해야 합니다.

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. 신규 대출에 대한 상환 유예 축소

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: 2027년 7월 1일 이후 실행된 대출의 경우 경제적 어려움 및 실업에 따른 상환 유예(deferment) 제도가 폐지될 예정입니다.

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: 지불 유예(forbearance) 규정도 강화됩니다.

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: 기존 대출은 일반적으로 영향을 받지 않지만, 본인의 상황에 맞게 확인해 볼 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## 유지되는 내용

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **기존 대출은 연방 대출 상태를 유지합니다.** 2026년 7월 이전에 받은 대출이라고 해서 새로운 유형의 대출로 자동 변경되지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **소득 기반 상환(IBR)은 계속 제공됩니다.** 현재의 많은 대출자들에게 계속해서 유효한 옵션으로 남습니다.

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **공공서비스 학자금 탕감(PSLF)** 제도는 계속 유지됩니다. RAP를 포함해 자격을 갖춘 플랜 하에서의 상환 횟수는 120회의 필수 상환 횟수에 합산됩니다. 고용주 자격 요건 규정이 여전히 중요하므로 최신 정의를 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **표준 상환, 기존 대출 이자율, 사망 및 장애 시 탕감과 같은 연방 보호 조치**는 계속 적용됩니다.

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - Direct Loan에 대한 **학부 대출 한도**는 대부분 변동이 없습니다.

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## 경과 규정 보호 조치

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: 2026년 7월 1일 이전에 이미 학위 과정에 등록되어 연방 대출을 받은 학생은 제한된 기간(일반적으로 최대 3학학년도 또는 예정된 학업 기간 중 짧은 쪽) 동안 기존 규정에 따라 대출을 계속 이용할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: 이 규정이 본인에게 적용되는지 학교의 재정 지원 사무실(financial aid office)에 문의하세요.

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## 확인해야 할 주요 날짜

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **2026년 7월 1일:** 신규 대출 한도 적용, 신규 대출자 대상 Grad PLUS 종료, RAP 옵션 제공 시작.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **2027년 7월 1일:** 신규 대출에 대한 상환 유예(deferment 및 forbearance) 옵션 변경 사항 적용.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **2028년 7월 1일:** SAVE, PAYE, ICR 이용자가 다른 플랜으로 전환해야 하는 목표 날짜 및 해당 구형 플랜 종료일.

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **개인별 마감일:** 연례 소득 재증명, 대출 통합 기간, 대출 관리 기관 안내 날짜는 대출자마다 다를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## 실용적인 체크리스트

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **StudentAid.gov에 로그인**하여 대출 유형, 잔액, 대출 관리 기관 및 현재 플랜을 확인하세요.

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **현재 이용 중인 플랜을 확인**하고, 해당 플랜이 단계적 폐지 대상에 포함되는지 파악하세요.

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **공식 Loan Simulator를 활용**하여 RAP, IBR 및 표준 플랜 하에서의 예상 상환액을 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. 대출 관리 기관의 안내를 받을 수 있도록 **연락처 정보를 최신 상태로 유지**하세요.

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. Parent PLUS 대출이나 구형 대출을 보유하고 있다면 **대출 통합 마감일을 주의 깊게 확인**하세요.

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **외부 업체의 제안에 주의하세요.** 정부 학자금 대출 관련 도움은 무료입니다. 선불 수수료를 요구하거나 보장된 탕감을 약속하는 업체는 철저히 검증해야 합니다.

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. 지원하기 훨씬 전에 새로운 한도와 비교하여 총비용을 산정함으로써 **대학원 진학 계획을 미리 세우세요**.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: 새로운 규칙은 상환 플랜 메뉴를 단순화하지만 절충 요소를 변경합니다. 즉, 고등 학위 및 부모에 대한 대출 한도가 낮아지고, 향후 단일한 주요 소득 연계 플랜으로 통합됩니다.

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: 대부분의 현재 대출자가 당장 즉각적인 변화에 직면한 것은 아니지만, 2028년 플랜 마감일과 대출 관리 기관의 안내 사항을 일정에 챙겨 두어야 합니다.

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: 가장 좋은 다음 단계는 마감 시한이 결정을 강요하기 전에 오늘 본인의 계정을 확인하고 옵션을 비교해 보는 것입니다.

zh.title: 学生贷款重置：新的还款规则对当今借款人意味着什么

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: 联邦学生贷款正处于多年来最大规模的改革之中。

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: 2025年7月签署的立法（通常称为《One Big Beautiful Bill Act》）改变了新贷款和现有贷款的偿还方式，并改变了学生和家长可以借贷的金额。

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: 本说明总结了要点，区分了哪些内容发生了变化，哪些内容保持不变，并列出了值得关注的日期。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供参考，不构成财务或法律建议。

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: 项目详情可能会由国会和教育部更新，因此请在 StudentAid.gov 或咨询您的贷款服务机构以确认具体信息。*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 简要版本

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - 一种新的收入驱动型选项，即**还款援助计划 (Repayment Assistance Plan, RAP)**，将取代2026年7月1日或之后发放的新贷款的几种旧计划。

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - **研究生 PLUS 贷款对新借款人终止**，且新的年度和终身限额适用于研究生、专业人员和家长 PLUS 贷款。

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - 许多当前的借款人暂时保留其现有计划，但一些计划正在逐步淘汰，且适用截止日期。

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## 正在发生的变化

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. 新的还款系统

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: 从2026年7月1日起，拥有新贷款的借款人可以在两个选项之间进行选择：

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **分级标准计划**，在取决于借款金额的期限内进行固定还款。

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **还款援助计划 (RAP)**，一种基于收入的计划。

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: 在 RAP 下，每月还款额基于调整后总收入，通常在收入的 1% 到 10% 之间，最低还款额为每月 $10。

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: 每位受抚养子女可减少还款额。

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: 两项功能旨在防止余额增长：如果您的还款额不足以支付每月利息，未付利息不会被累加；并且对于每笔按时还款，政府会匹配部分本金减免（最高 $50）。

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: 剩余余额在符合条件的还款 30 年后予以免除。

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. 旧的收入驱动型计划正在逐步淘汰

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: 根据新法律，SAVE、PAYE 和 ICR 计划正在逐步结束，预计使用这些计划的借款人将在 **2028年7月1日** 之前转至其他计划，例如 RAP 或基于收入的还款 (IBR)。

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: SAVE 计划也陷入了法律挑战，许多 SAVE 借款人一直处于暂停状态。

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: 如果您属于这种情况，请留意服务机构的通知，不要认为您的状态是永久性的。

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. 研究生和专业人员借款上限

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: 对于2026年7月1日或之后的新借款人：

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | 贷款类型 | 年度限额 | 总限额 |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
| Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
| Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | 研究生和专业学习的终身上限 | | $257,500（不包括本科贷款） |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Grad PLUS 贷款不再向新借款人提供。

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: 需要超过上限金额的学生可能不得不求助于储蓄、奖学金、雇主援助或私人贷款，这些通常缺乏联邦保护，如收入驱动型还款。

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. 家长 PLUS 限额

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: 新的家长 PLUS 借款上限为 **每位受抚养学生每年 $20,000，总计 $65,000**。

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: 已经持有家长 PLUS 贷款（尤其是合并贷款）的家长应检查他们仍有哪些还款选项。

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: 通常，某些合并的家长 PLUS 贷款必须满足特定的合并和注册截止日期，才能继续使用收入驱动型选项。

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. 新贷款的暂停次数减少

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: 对于2027年7月1日之后发放的贷款，经济困难和失业延期还款计划将被取消。

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: 宽限规则也已收紧。

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: 现有贷款通常不受影响，但这值得针对您的情况进行确认。

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## 保持不变的内容

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **现有贷款仍然是联邦贷款。** 在2026年7月之前发放的贷款不会变成新型贷款。

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **基于收入的还款 (IBR) 仍然可用。** 它仍然是许多当前借款人的一个选项。

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **公共服务贷款免除 (PSLF)** 继续存在。在符合条件的计划（包括 RAP）下的合格还款计入所需的 120 次还款。雇主资格规则仍然是关注焦点，因此请查看当前的定义。

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **标准还款、现有贷款的利率以及联邦保护**（如死亡和残疾免除）继续有效。

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - **直接贷款的本科借款限额**基本保持不变。

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## 过渡保护

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: 在2026年7月1日之前已经注册学位课程并为此获得联邦贷款的学生，可能可以在有限的时间内继续按照旧规则借款，通常最长为三个学年或课程的预期长度，以较短者为准。

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: 请向您学校的经济援助办公室询问这是否适用于您。

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## 需要检查的日期

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **2026年7月1日：** 新的贷款限额、新借款人的 Grad PLUS 终止以及 RAP 可用性开始。

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **2027年7月1日：** 新贷款的延期和宽限选项的变更生效。

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **2028年7月1日：** SAVE、PAYE 和 ICR 借款人转至其他计划的目标日期，以及旧计划关闭的日期。

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **您自己的截止日期：** 年度收入重新认证、合并窗口和服务机构通知日期可能因借款人而异。

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## 实用清单

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **登录 StudentAid.gov** 并确认您的贷款类型、余额、服务机构和当前计划。

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **检查您所在的计划**，以及它是否属于正在逐步淘汰的计划之列。

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **使用官方贷款模拟器 (Loan Simulator)** 比较您在 RAP、IBR 和标准计划下的预估还款额。

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. **保持您的联系信息最新**，以便您能收到服务机构的通知。

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **如果您持有家长 PLUS 贷款或旧类型的贷款，请留意合并截止日期**。

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **小心外部报价。** 政府贷款帮助是免费的。收取预付费用或承诺保证免除贷款的公司值得审查。

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. **提前为研究生院做计划**，在申请前仔细估算总成本与新上限的对比。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: 新规则简化了还款计划菜单，但改变了权衡：降低了高级学位和家长的借款上限，并推行单一的主要收入驱动型计划。

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: 大多数当前借款人不会面临立即的变化，但 2028 年的计划截止日期和任何服务机构的通知都应记录在您的日历上。

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: 最好的下一步是今天检查您的账户，并在截止日期迫使您做出决定之前比较您的选项。

hi.title: छात्र ऋण रीसेट: नए पुनर्भुगतान नियम आज के उधारकर्ताओं के लिए क्या मायने रखते हैं

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: संघीय छात्र ऋण वर्षों में अपने सबसे बड़े बदलाव के दौर से गुजर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: जुलाई 2025 में हस्ताक्षरित कानून (जिसे आमतौर पर 'वन बिग ब्यूटीफुल बिल एक्ट' कहा जाता है) यह बदलता है कि नए और मौजूदा ऋणों का पुनर्भुगतान कैसे किया जाता है, और यह बदलता है कि छात्र और माता-पिता कितना उधार ले सकते हैं।

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: यह व्याख्या मुख्य बिंदुओं का सारांश प्रस्तुत करती है, जो बदल रहा है उसे जो नहीं बदल रहा है उससे अलग करती है, और उन तारीखों को सूचीबद्ध करती है जिन्हें जांचना आवश्यक है।

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी है, न कि वित्तीय या कानूनी सलाह।

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: कार्यक्रम का विवरण कांग्रेस और शिक्षा विभाग द्वारा अपडेट किया जा सकता है, इसलिए StudentAid.gov पर या अपने ऋण सेवा प्रदाता के साथ विशिष्टताओं की पुष्टि करें।*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## संक्षिप्त संस्करण

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - एक नया आय-आधारित विकल्प, **रिपेमेंट असिस्टेंस प्लान (RAP)**, 1 जुलाई, 2026 को या उसके बाद लिए गए नए ऋणों के लिए कई पुरानी योजनाओं की जगह लेता है।

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - नए उधारकर्ताओं के लिए **ग्रेजुएट PLUS ऋण समाप्त** हो रहे हैं, और स्नातक, पेशेवर और पैरेंट PLUS ऋणों पर नई वार्षिक और आजीवन सीमाएं लागू होती हैं।

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - कई मौजूदा उधारकर्ता अभी के लिए अपनी मौजूदा योजनाओं को बनाए रखेंगे, लेकिन कुछ योजनाओं को चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त किया जा रहा है, और समय सीमाएं लागू होती हैं।

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## क्या बदल रहा है

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. एक नई पुनर्भुगतान प्रणाली

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: 1 जुलाई, 2026 से, नए ऋण वाले उधारकर्ता दो विकल्पों में से चुन सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **एक स्तरीय मानक योजना**, जिसमें उधार ली गई राशि के आधार पर एक अवधि के लिए निश्चित भुगतान होता है।

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **रिपेमेंट असिस्टेंस प्लान (RAP)**, एक आय-आधारित योजना।

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: RAP के तहत, मासिक भुगतान समायोजित सकल आय पर आधारित होते हैं, जो आमतौर पर आय का लगभग 1% से 10% तक होते हैं, जिसमें न्यूनतम भुगतान $10 प्रति माह होता है।

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक आश्रित बच्चे के लिए भुगतान कम कर दिया जाता है।

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: दो विशेषताएं शेष राशि को बढ़ने से रोकने के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई हैं: यदि आपका भुगतान मासिक ब्याज को कवर नहीं करता है, तो अवैतनिक ब्याज नहीं जोड़ा जाता है, और प्रत्येक समय पर भुगतान के लिए सरकार मूलधन में कमी का एक हिस्सा ( $50 तक) मिलाती है।

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: पात्र भुगतान के 30 वर्षों के बाद शेष राशि माफ कर दी जाती है।

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. पुरानी आय-आधारित योजनाओं को चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त किया जा रहा है

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: SAVE, PAYE और ICR योजनाओं को नए कानून के तहत समाप्त किया जा रहा है, और उन पर मौजूद उधारकर्ताओं से **1 जुलाई, 2028** तक किसी अन्य योजना, जैसे RAP या इनकम-बेस्ड रिपेमेंट (IBR), पर जाने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: SAVE भी अदालती चुनौतियों में उलझा हुआ है, और कई SAVE उधारकर्ता रुके हुए (paused) स्टेटस में हैं।

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: यदि यह आप पर लागू होता है, तो अपने सेवा प्रदाता से नोटिस देखें और यह न मानें कि आपकी स्थिति स्थायी है।

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. स्नातक और पेशेवर उधार लेने की सीमाएं

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: 1 जुलाई, 2026 को या उसके बाद नए उधारकर्ताओं के लिए:

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | ऋण का प्रकार | वार्षिक सीमा | कुल सीमा |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
| Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
| Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | स्नातक और पेशेवर अध्ययन में आजीवन सीमा | | $257,500 (स्नातक ऋणों को छोड़कर) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Grad PLUS ऋण अब नए उधारकर्ताओं के लिए उपलब्ध नहीं हैं।

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: जिन छात्रों को सीमाओं से अधिक की आवश्यकता है, उन्हें बचत, छात्रवृत्ति, नियोक्ता सहायता, या निजी ऋणों का सहारा लेना पड़ सकता है, जिनमें आमतौर पर आय-आधारित पुनर्भुगतान जैसी संघीय सुरक्षा का अभाव होता है।

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. पैरेंट PLUS सीमाएं

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: नया पैरेंट PLUS उधार **$20,000 प्रति वर्ष और प्रति आश्रित छात्र $65,000 कुल** तक सीमित है।

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: जिन माता-पिता के पास पहले से ही पैरेंट PLUS ऋण हैं, विशेष रूप से समेकित (consolidated) वाले, उन्हें यह जांचना चाहिए कि उनके पास अभी भी कौन से पुनर्भुगतान विकल्प होंगे।

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: सामान्य तौर पर, कुछ समेकित पैरेंट PLUS ऋणों को आय-आधारित विकल्प तक पहुंच बनाए रखने के लिए विशिष्ट समेकन और नामांकन समय सीमा को पूरा करना होगा।

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. नए ऋणों के लिए कम ठहराव (pauses)

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: 1 जुलाई, 2027 के बाद लिए गए ऋणों के लिए, आर्थिक कठिनाई और बेरोजगारी स्थगन (deferments) को हटाने का कार्यक्रम है।

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: फोरबेरेंस (forbearance) नियमों को भी कड़ा किया गया है।

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: मौजूदा ऋण आमतौर पर प्रभावित नहीं होते हैं, लेकिन आपकी स्थिति के लिए इसकी पुष्टि करना उचित है।

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## क्या नहीं बदल रहा है

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **मौजूदा ऋण संघीय ऋण बने रहेंगे।** जुलाई 2026 से पहले लिए गए ऋण को नए प्रकार के ऋण में नहीं बदला जाता है।

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **इनकम-बेस्ड रिपेमेंट (IBR) उपलब्ध रहेगा।** यह कई मौजूदा उधारकर्ताओं के लिए एक विकल्प बना हुआ है।

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **पब्लिक सर्विस लोन फॉरगिवनेस (PSLF)** का अस्तित्व बना रहेगा। RAP सहित पात्र योजनाओं के तहत किए गए भुगतान 120 आवश्यक भुगतानों में गिने जाते हैं। नियोक्ता पात्रता नियम सुर्खियों में बने हुए हैं, इसलिए वर्तमान परिभाषाओं की जांच करें।

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **मानक पुनर्भुगतान, मौजूदा ऋणों पर ब्याज दरें और संघीय सुरक्षा** जैसे मृत्यु और विकलांगता डिस्चार्ज जारी रहेंगे।

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - प्रत्यक्ष ऋणों के लिए **स्नातक उधार सीमाएं** काफी हद तक अपरिवर्तित हैं।

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## संक्रमण सुरक्षा

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: जो छात्र पहले से ही किसी डिग्री प्रोग्राम में नामांकित थे और उन्होंने 1 जुलाई, 2026 से पहले इसके लिए संघीय ऋण प्राप्त किया था, वे सीमित अवधि के लिए पुराने नियमों के तहत उधार लेना जारी रख सकते हैं, जो आमतौर पर तीन शैक्षणिक वर्षों या कार्यक्रम की अपेक्षित अवधि तक होता है, जो भी कम हो।

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: अपने स्कूल के वित्तीय सहायता कार्यालय से पूछें कि क्या यह आप पर लागू होता है।

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## जांचने योग्य तारीखें

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **1 जुलाई, 2026:** नई ऋण सीमाएं, नए उधारकर्ताओं के लिए Grad PLUS का अंत, और RAP उपलब्धता शुरू।

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **1 जुलाई, 2027:** नए ऋणों के लिए स्थगन और फोरबेरेंस विकल्पों में बदलाव प्रभावी।

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **1 जुलाई, 2028:** SAVE, PAYE और ICR पर उधारकर्ताओं के लिए किसी अन्य योजना पर जाने और पुरानी योजनाओं को बंद करने की लक्ष्य तिथि।

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **आपकी अपनी समय सीमा:** वार्षिक आय पुन: प्रमाणन, समेकन विंडो और सेवा प्रदाता नोटिस तिथियां उधारकर्ता के अनुसार भिन्न हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## एक व्यावहारिक चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **StudentAid.gov पर लॉग इन करें** और अपने ऋण के प्रकार, शेष राशि, सेवा प्रदाता और वर्तमान योजना की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **जांचें कि आप किस योजना पर हैं** और क्या यह उन योजनाओं में से है जिन्हें चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त किया जा रहा है।

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **आधिकारिक लोन सिम्युलेटर का उपयोग करें** ताकि RAP, IBR और मानक योजना के तहत अपने अनुमानित भुगतानों की तुलना कर सकें।

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. **अपनी संपर्क जानकारी को अपडेट रखें** ताकि आपको सेवा प्रदाता के नोटिस प्राप्त हो सकें।

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **समेकन समय सीमा पर नज़र रखें** यदि आपके पास पैरेंट PLUS ऋण या पुराने प्रकार के ऋण हैं।

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **बाहरी प्रस्तावों से सावधान रहें।** सरकारी ऋण सहायता निःशुल्क है। जो कंपनियां अग्रिम शुल्क लेती हैं या गारंटीकृत माफी का वादा करती हैं, उनकी जांच की जानी चाहिए।

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. **ग्रेजुएट स्कूल के लिए पहले से योजना बनाएं** और आवेदन करने से काफी पहले नई सीमाओं के मुकाबले कुल लागत का अनुमान लगाएं।

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: नए नियम पुनर्भुगतान योजनाओं के मेनू को सरल बनाते हैं लेकिन ट्रेड-ऑफ को बदलते हैं: उन्नत डिग्री और माता-पिता के लिए कम उधार सीमाएं, और आगे चलकर एक एकल मुख्य आय-आधारित योजना।

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: अधिकांश मौजूदा उधारकर्ताओं को तत्काल बदलाव का सामना नहीं करना पड़ रहा है, लेकिन 2028 की योजना की समय सीमा और किसी भी सेवा प्रदाता नोटिस को आपके कैलेंडर पर होना चाहिए।

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: सबसे अच्छा अगला कदम आज ही अपने खाते की जांच करना और समय सीमा के कारण निर्णय लेने से पहले अपने विकल्पों की तुलना करना है।

es.title: La reestructuración de los préstamos estudiantiles: Qué significan las nuevas reglas de pago para los prestatarios de hoy

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: Los préstamos federales para estudiantes se encuentran en medio de su mayor revisión en años.

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: La legislación firmada en julio de 2025 (comúnmente llamada One Big Beautiful Bill Act) cambia la forma en que se pagan los préstamos nuevos y existentes, y modifica cuánto pueden pedir prestado los estudiantes y los padres.

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: Esta guía resume los puntos principales, separa lo que cambia de lo que sigue igual y enumera las fechas que vale la pena revisar.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es información general, no asesoramiento financiero ni legal.

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Los detalles del programa pueden ser actualizados por el Congreso y el Departamento de Educación, así que confirme los detalles específicos en StudentAid.gov o con su administrador de préstamos.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## La versión corta

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - Una nueva opción basada en los ingresos, el **Plan de Asistencia para el Pago (RAP)**, reemplaza a varios planes anteriores para los nuevos préstamos emitidos a partir del 1 de julio de 2026.

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - **Terminan los préstamos Grad PLUS** para los nuevos prestatarios, y se aplican nuevos límites anuales y de por vida a los préstamos de posgrado, profesionales y Parent PLUS.

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - Muchos prestatarios actuales mantienen sus planes existentes por ahora, pero algunos planes se están eliminando gradualmente y se aplican plazos.

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## Qué está cambiando

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. Un nuevo sistema de pago

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: A partir del 1 de julio de 2026, los prestatarios con nuevos préstamos eligen entre dos opciones:

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **Un plan estándar escalonado**, con pagos fijos durante un plazo que depende de la cantidad pedida prestada.

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **El Plan de Asistencia para el Pago (RAP)**, un plan basado en los ingresos.

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: Bajo el RAP, los pagos mensuales se basan en el ingreso bruto ajustado, generalmente oscilando entre aproximadamente el 1% y el 10% de los ingresos, con un pago mínimo de $10 por mes.

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: El pago se reduce por cada hijo dependiente.

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: Dos características están diseñadas para evitar que los saldos crezcan: si su pago no cubre el interés mensual, el interés no pagado no se agrega, y por cada pago puntual el gobierno iguala parte de la reducción del principal (hasta $50).

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: Los saldos restantes se condonan después de 30 años de pagos elegibles.

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. Los planes anteriores basados en los ingresos se están eliminando gradualmente

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: Los planes SAVE, PAYE e ICR se están cancelando bajo la nueva ley, y se espera que los prestatarios en ellos se cambien a otro plan, como RAP o Repago Basado en Ingresos (IBR), para el **1 de julio de 2028**.

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: SAVE también ha estado envuelto en desafíos legales, y muchos prestatarios de SAVE han estado en un estado de pausa.

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: Si eso lo describe a usted, esté atento a los avisos de su administrador y no asuma que su estado es permanente.

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. Límites de préstamos de posgrado y profesionales

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: Para los nuevos prestatarios a partir del 1 de julio de 2026:

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |

segments.src: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Los préstamos Grad PLUS ya no están disponibles para los nuevos prestatarios.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: Los estudiantes que necesiten más de lo que permiten los límites pueden tener que recurrir a ahorros, becas, ayuda del empleador o préstamos privados, los cuales generalmente carecen de protecciones federales como el pago basado en los ingresos.

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. Límites de Parent PLUS

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: Los nuevos préstamos Parent PLUS tienen un límite de **$20,000 por año y $65,000 en total por estudiante dependiente**.

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: Los padres que ya tienen préstamos Parent PLUS, especialmente los consolidados, deben verificar qué opciones de pago aún tendrán.

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: En general, ciertos préstamos Parent PLUS consolidados deben cumplir con plazos específicos de consolidación e inscripción para mantener el acceso a una opción basada en los ingresos.

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. Menos pausas para los nuevos préstamos

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: Para los préstamos emitidos después del 1 de julio de 2027, las aplazamientos por dificultades económicas y desempleo están programados para eliminarse.

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: Las reglas de indulgencia también se endurecen.

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: Los préstamos existentes generalmente no se ven afectados, pero vale la pena confirmarlo para su situación.

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue igual

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **Los préstamos existentes siguen siendo préstamos federales.** Tener un préstamo obtenido antes de julio de 2026 no lo convierte en un nuevo tipo de préstamo.

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **El Repago Basado en Ingresos (IBR) sigue disponible.** Continúa siendo una opción para muchos prestatarios actuales.

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **La Condonación de Préstamos por Servicio Público (PSLF)** sigue existiendo. Los pagos elegibles bajo planes elegibles, incluido el RAP, cuentan para los 120 pagos requeridos. Las reglas de elegibilidad del empleador siguen en el centro de atención, así que verifique las definiciones actuales.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **El pago estándar, las tasas de interés en los préstamos existentes y las protecciones federales** como la condonación por muerte y discapacidad continúan.

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Los límites de préstamos para pregrado** para préstamos directos permanecen prácticamente inalterados.

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## Protecciones de transición

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: Los estudiantes que ya estaban inscritos en un programa de grado y habían recibido un préstamo federal para este antes del 1 de julio de 2026 pueden seguir pidiendo prestado bajo las reglas anteriores por un período limitado, generalmente hasta tres años académicos o la duración esperada del programa, lo que sea más corto.

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: Pregunte en la oficina de ayuda financiera de su escuela si esto se aplica a usted.

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## Fechas a revisar

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **1 de julio de 2026:** Comienzan los nuevos límites de préstamos, el fin de Grad PLUS para nuevos prestatarios y la disponibilidad del RAP.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **1 de julio de 2027:** Entran en vigor los cambios en las opciones de aplazamiento e indulgencia para los nuevos préstamos.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **1 de julio de 2028:** Fecha objetivo para que los prestatarios en SAVE, PAYE e ICR se cambien a otro plan, y para el cierre de los planes anteriores.

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## Una lista de verificación práctica

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Verifique en qué plan se encuentra** y si está entre los que se están eliminando.

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **Esté atento a los plazos de consolidación** si tiene préstamos Parent PLUS o tipos de préstamos más antiguos.

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **Tenga cuidado con las ofertas externas.** La ayuda gubernamental para préstamos es gratuita. Las empresas que cobran tarifas por adelantado o prometen condonación garantizada merecen escrutinio.

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.

segments.src: ## Bottom line

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: Las nuevas reglas simplifican el menú de planes de pago pero cambian las compensaciones: límites de endeudamiento más bajos para títulos avanzados y padres, y un único plan principal basado en los ingresos en el futuro.

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los prestatarios actuales no enfrentan un cambio inmediato, pero la fecha límite del plan de 2028 y cualquier aviso del administrador deben estar en su calendario.

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: El mejor siguiente paso es revisar su cuenta hoy y comparar sus opciones antes de que una fecha límite fuerce la decisión.

ar.title: إعادة ضبط القروض الطلابية: ماذا تعني قواعد السداد الجديدة للمقترضين اليوم

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: القروض الطلابية الفيدرالية في منتصف أكبر عملية إصلاح لها منذ سنوات.

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: التشريع المُوقّع في يوليو 2025 (والمعروف عموماً بقانون One Big Beautiful Bill Act) يغير كيفية سداد القروض الجديدة والحالية، كما يغير المبلغ الذي يمكن للطلاب وآبائهم اقتراضه.

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: يلخص هذا الشرح النقاط الرئيسية، ويفصل ما يتغير عما يظل كما هو، ويسرد التواريخ التي تستحق التحقق منها.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة عبارة عن معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة مالية أو قانونية.

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: يمكن تحديث تفاصيل البرنامج من قبل الكونغرس ووزارة التعليم، لذا تأكد من التفاصيل المحددة على StudentAid.gov أو مع جهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## النسخة المختصرة

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - خيار جديد قائم على الدخل، وهو **خطة مساعدة السداد (RAP)**، يحل محل عدة خطط قديمة للقروض الجديدة المُقدمة في أو بعد 1 يوليو 2026.

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - **تنتهي قروض Grad PLUS** للمقترضين الجدد، وتُطبق حدود سنوية ومدى الحياة جديدة على قروض الدراسات العليا والمهنية وقروض Parent PLUS.

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - يحتفظ العديد من المقترضين الحاليين بخططهم الحالية في الوقت الحالي، ولكن يتم التخلص التدريجي من بعض الخطط، وتُطبق المواعيد النهائية.

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يتغير

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. نظام سداد جديد

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: اعتباراً من 1 يوليو 2026، يختار المقترضون الحاصلون على قروض جديدة بين خيارين:

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **خطة قياسية متدرجة**، مدفوعات ثابتة على مدى فترة تعتمد على المبلغ المُقترض.

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **خطة مساعدة السداد (RAP)**، وهي خطة تعتمد على الدخل.

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: بموجب خطة RAP، تعتمد المدفوعات الشهرية على إجمالي الدخل المعدل، وتتراوح عموماً بين حوالي 1% و10% من الدخل، بحد أدنى للدفع يبلغ 10 دولارات شهرياً.

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: يتم تخفيض الدفع لكل طفل معال.

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: تم تصميم ميزتين لمنع الأرصدة من النمو: إذا كان دفعتك لا تغطي الفائدة الشهرية، فلا يتم إضافة الفائدة غير المدفوعة، ولتحديد كل دفعة في موعدها تطابق الحكومة جزءاً من تخفيض أصل القرض (حتى 50 دولاراً).

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: يتم إسقاط الأرصدة المتبقية بعد 30 عاماً من المدفوعات المؤهلة.

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. التخلص التدريجي من الخطط القديمة القائمة على الدخل

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: يتم إنهاء خطط SAVE وPAYE وICR بموجب القانون الجديد، ومن المتوقع أن ينتقل المقترضون عليها إلى خطة أخرى، مثل RAP أو السداد القائم على الدخل (IBR)، بحلول **1 يوليو 2028**.

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: كما تورطت خطة SAVE في تحديات قضائية، وكان العديد من مقترضي SAVE في حالة وقفة مؤقتة.

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: إذا كان ذلك يصف حالتك، ترقب الإشعارات من جهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك ولا تفترض أن وضعك دائم.

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. حدود اقتراض الدراسات العليا والمهنية

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: للمقترضين الجدد في أو بعد 1 يوليو 2026:

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |

segments.src: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: لم تعد قروض Grad PLUS متاحة للمقترضين الجدد.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: قد يضطر الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى أكثر مما تسمح به الحدود إلى اللجوء إلى المدخرات، أو المنح الدراسية، أو مساعدات أصحاب العمل، أو القروض الخاصة، والتي تفتقر عموماً إلى الحماية الفيدرالية مثل السداد القائم على الدخل.

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. حدود Parent PLUS

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: يقتصر اقتراض Parent PLUS الجديد على **20,000 دولار سنوياً و65,000 دولار إجمالاً لكل طالب معال**.

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: يجب على الآباء الذين لديهم بالفعل قروض Parent PLUS، وخاصة المدمجة منها، التحقق من خيارات السداد التي سيظلون يمتلكونها.

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: بشكل عام، يجب أن تلبي بعض قروض Parent PLUS المدمجة مواعيد نهائية محددة للدمج والتسجيل للحفاظ على الوصول إلى خيار يعتمد على الدخل.

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. وقفات أقل للقروض الجديدة

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للقروض المُقدمة بعد 1 يوليو 2027، من المقرر إزالة تأجيلات الصعوبات الاقتصادية والبطالة.

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: كما تم تشديد قواعد الإعفاء.

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: لا تتأثر القروض الحالية عموماً، ولكن يجدر تأكيد ذلك لحالتك.

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## ما يظل كما هو

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **تظل القروض الحالية قروضاً فيدرالية.** الحصول على قرض تم إجراؤه قبل يوليو 2026 لا يحوله إلى نوع جديد من القروض.

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **يظل السداد القائم على الدخل (IBR) متاحاً.** يستمر في كونها خياراً للعديد من المقترضين الحاليين.

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **إعفاء القروض للخدمة العامة (PSLF)** يظل موجوداً. تحتسب المدفوعات المؤهلة بموجب الخطط المؤهلة، بما في ذلك RAP، ضمن المدفوعات الـ 120 المطلوبة. لا تزال قواعد أهلية صاحب العمل في دائرة الضوء، لذا تحقق من التعريفات الحالية.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **السداد القياسي، وأسعار الفائدة على القروض الحالية والحماية الفيدرالية** مثل الإبراء بسبب الوفاة والإعاقة مستمرة.

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - **حدود اقتراض المرحلة الجامعية** للقروض المباشرة لم تتغير إلى حد كبير.

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## حماية الانتقال

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: الطلاب الذين كانوا مسجلين بالفعل في برنامج دراسي وحصلوا على قرض فيدرالي له قبل 1 يوليو 2026 قد يتمكنون من الاستمرار في الاقتراض بموجب القواعد القديمة لفترة محدودة، وعموماً لمدة تصل إلى ثلاث سنوات دراسية أو الطول المتوقع للبرنامج، أيهما أقصر.

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: اسأل مكتب المساعدات المالية بمدرستك عما إذا كان هذا ينطبق عليك.

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## تواريخ يجب التحقق منها

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **1 يوليو 2026:** تبدأ حدود القروض الجديدة، ونهاية Grad PLUS للمقترضين الجدد، وتوفر خطة RAP.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **1 يوليو 2027:** تدخل التغييرات على خيارات التأجيل والإعفاء للقروض الجديدة حيز التنفيذ.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **1 يوليو 2028:** التاريخ المستهدف للمقترضين على SAVE وPAYE وICR للانتقال إلى خطة أخرى، ولإغلاق الخطط القديمة.

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **مواعيدك النهائية الخاصة:** إعادة اعتماد الدخل السنوي، وفترات الدمج، وتواريخ إشعار جهة خدمة القروض يمكن أن تختلف حسب المقترض.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## قائمة تحقق عملية

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **تسجيل الدخول إلى StudentAid.gov** وتأكيد أنواع القروض والأرصدة وجهة خدمة القروض والخطة الحالية.

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **تحقق من الخطة التي تتبعها** وما إذا كانت من بين تلك التي يتم التخلص التدريجي منها.

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **استخدم محاكي القروض الرسمي** لمقارنة مدفوعاتك المقدرة بموجب خطط RAP وIBR والخطة القياسية.

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. **حافظ على تحديث معلومات الاتصال الخاصة بك** حتى تتلقى إشعارات جهة خدمة القروض.

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **ترقب المواعيد النهائية للدمج** إذا كنت تحتفظ بقروض Parent PLUS أو أنواع القروض القديمة.

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **كن حذراً من العروض الخارجية.** مساعدة القروض الحكومية مجانية. الشركات التي تفرض رسوماً مسبقة أو تعد بالإعفاء المضمون تستحق التدقيق.

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. **خطط للمستقبل لدراسات الدراسات العليا** من خلال تقدير التكاليف الإجمالية مقابل الحدود الجديدة قبل وقت طويل من التقديم.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## خلاصة القول

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: تبسط القواعد الجديدة قائمة خطط السداد ولكنها تغيّر المقايضات: سقوف اقتراض أقل للدرجات المتقدمة والآباء، وخطة رئيسية واحدة تعتمد على الدخل للمضي قدماً.

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: لا يواجه معظم المقترضين الحاليين تغييراً فورياً، ولكن يجب أن تكون الموعد النهائي لخطة 2028 وأي إشعارات من جهة خدمة القروض على تقويمك.

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: أفضل خطوة التالية هي التحقق من حسابك اليوم ومقارنة خياراتك قبل أن يفرض موعد نهائي القرار.
