segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: Dans le cadre du RAP, les paiements mensuels sont basés sur le revenu brut ajusté, allant généralement d'environ 1 % à 10 % du revenu, avec un paiement minimum de 10 $ par mois.

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: Le paiement est réduit pour chaque enfant à charge.

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: Deux fonctionnalités sont conçues pour empêcher la croissance des soldes : si votre paiement ne couvre pas les intérêts mensuels, les intérêts impayés ne sont pas ajoutés, et pour chaque paiement effectué à temps, le gouvernement complète une partie de la réduction du principal (jusqu'à 50 $).

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: Les soldes restants sont annulés après 30 ans de paiements admissibles.

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. Les anciens plans basés sur le revenu sont progressivement supprimés

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: Les plans SAVE, PAYE et ICR sont en cours de liquidation en vertu de la nouvelle loi, et les emprunteurs qui y sont inscrits sont censés passer à un autre plan, tel que le RAP ou le Remboursement basé sur le revenu (IBR), d'ici le **1er juillet 2028**.

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: SAVE a également été bloqué par des contestations judiciaires, et de nombreux emprunteurs SAVE ont été placés dans un statut de pause.

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: Si cela vous concerne, surveillez les avis de votre gestionnaire et ne présumez pas que votre statut est permanent.

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. Plafonds d'emprunt pour les études supérieures et professionnelles

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: Pour les nouveaux emprunteurs à partir du 1er juillet 2026 :

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Type de prêt | Limite annuelle | Limite globale |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Études supérieures (non professionnel) | 20 500 $ | 100 000 $ |

segments.src: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Professionnel (tel que médecine ou droit) | 50 000 $ | 200 000 $ |

segments.src: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | Plafond à vie pour les études supérieures et professionnelles | | 257 500 $ (exclut les prêts de premier cycle) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Les prêts Grad PLUS ne sont plus disponibles pour les nouveaux emprunteurs.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: Les étudiants qui ont besoin de plus que ce que permettent les plafonds devront peut-être se tourner vers l'épargne, les bourses, l'aide de l'employeur ou les prêts privés, qui manquent généralement de protections fédérales telles que le remboursement basé sur le revenu.

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. Limites des prêts Parent PLUS

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: Les nouveaux emprunts Parent PLUS sont plafonnés à **20 000 $ par an et 65 000 $ au total par étudiant à charge**.

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: Les parents qui détiennent déjà des prêts Parent PLUS, en particulier ceux consolidés, devraient vérifier quelles options de remboursement ils conserveront.

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: En général, certains prêts Parent PLUS consolidés doivent respecter des délais spécifiques de consolidation et d'inscription pour conserver l'accès à une option basée sur le revenu.

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. Moins de pauses pour les nouveaux prêts

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: Pour les prêts contractés après le 1er juillet 2027, les reports pour difficultés économiques et chômage devraient être supprimés.

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: Les règles de report de paiement (forbearance) sont également durcies.

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: Les prêts existants ne sont généralement pas affectés, mais cela mérite d'être confirmé pour votre situation.

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## Ce qui reste inchangé

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **Les prêts existants restent des prêts fédéraux.** Avoir un prêt contracté avant juillet 2026 ne le transforme pas en un nouveau type de prêt.

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **Le Remboursement basé sur le revenu (IBR) reste disponible.** Il continue d'être une option pour de nombreux emprunteurs actuels.

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **Le programme de remise de prêt pour service public (PSLF)** continue d'exister. Les paiements admissibles dans le cadre des plans éligibles, y compris le RAP, comptent pour les 120 paiements requis. Les règles d'éligibilité de l'employeur restent sous les projecteurs, vérifiez donc les définitions actuelles.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **Le remboursement standard, les taux d'intérêt sur les prêts existants et les protections fédérales** telles que l'annulation en cas de décès ou d'invalidité continuent.

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Les limites d'emprunt de premier cycle** pour les prêts directs sont largement inchangées.

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## Protections de transition

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: Les étudiants qui étaient déjà inscrits dans un programme diplômant et qui avaient reçu un prêt fédéral pour celui-ci avant le 1er juillet 2026 pourraient être en mesure de continuer à emprunter selon les anciennes règles pour une période limitée, généralement jusqu'à trois années universitaires ou la durée prévue du programme, selon la plus courte des deux.

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: Demandez au bureau d'aide financière de votre établissement si cela s'applique à vous.

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## Dates à vérifier

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **1er juillet 2026 :** Nouvelles limites de prêt, fin des Grad PLUS pour les nouveaux emprunteurs, et début de la disponibilité du RAP.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **1er juillet 2027 :** Les changements apportés aux options de report et de report de paiement pour les nouveaux prêts entrent en vigueur.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **1er juillet 2028 :** Date cible pour que les emprunteurs sous SAVE, PAYE et ICR passent à un autre plan, et pour la fermeture des anciens plans.

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **Vos propres échéances :** La recertification annuelle des revenus, les fenêtres de consolidation et les dates d'avis du gestionnaire peuvent différer selon l'emprunteur.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## Une liste de contrôle pratique

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **Connectez-vous sur StudentAid.gov** et confirmez vos types de prêts, soldes, gestionnaire et plan actuel.

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Vérifiez quel plan vous utilisez** et s'il fait partie de ceux qui sont progressivement supprimés.

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **Utilisez le simulateur de prêt officiel** pour comparer vos paiements estimés selon le RAP, l'IBR et le plan standard.

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. **Maintenez vos coordonnées à jour** afin de recevoir les avis de votre gestionnaire.

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **Surveillez les délais de consolidation** si vous détenez des prêts Parent PLUS ou des types de prêts plus anciens.

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **Soyez prudent avec les offres extérieures.** L'aide aux prêts gouvernementaux est gratuite. Les entreprises qui facturent des frais initiaux ou promettent une remise garantie méritent d'être examinées.

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. **Planifiez à l'avance pour les études supérieures** en estimant les coûts totaux par rapport aux nouveaux plafonds bien avant de postuler.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: Les nouvelles règles simplifient le menu des plans de remboursement mais modifient les compromis : plafonds d'emprunt plus bas pour les diplômes avancés et les parents, et un seul plan principal basé sur le revenu à l'avenir.

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: La plupart des emprunteurs actuels ne sont pas confrontés à un changement immédiat, mais l'échéance du plan de 2028 et tout avis de gestionnaire doivent figurer sur votre calendrier.

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: La meilleure prochaine étape est de vérifier votre compte aujourd'hui et de comparer vos options avant qu'une échéance ne force la décision.

pt.title: O Ajuste dos Empréstimos Estudantis: O que as Novas Regras de Reembolso Significam para os Mutuários de Hoje

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: Os empréstimos estudantis federais estão passando pela sua maior reformulação em anos.

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: A legislação assinada em julho de 2025 (comumente chamada de One Big Beautiful Bill Act) altera a forma como empréstimos novos e existentes são reembolsados, e muda quanto estudantes e pais podem tomar emprestado.

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: Este guia explica os pontos principais, separa o que muda do que permanece igual e lista as datas que vale a pena verificar.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é uma informação geral, não um conselho financeiro ou jurídico.

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Os detalhes do programa podem ser atualizados pelo Congresso e pelo Departamento de Educação, portanto, confirme as especificidades em StudentAid.gov ou com seu administrador de empréstimos.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## A versão resumida

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - Uma nova opção baseada na renda, o **Plano de Assistência ao Reembolso (RAP)**, substitui vários planos antigos para novos empréstimos feitos em ou após 1º de julho de 2026.

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - **Os empréstimos Graduate PLUS terminam** para novos mutuários, e novos limites anuais e vitalícios se aplicam a empréstimos de pós-graduação, profissionais e Parent PLUS.

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - Muitos mutuários atuais mantêm seus planos existentes por enquanto, mas alguns planos estão sendo eliminados gradualmente, e prazos se aplicam.

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## O que está mudando

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. Um novo sistema de reembolso

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: A partir de 1º de julho de 2026, mutuários com novos empréstimos escolhem entre duas opções:

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **Um plano padrão escalonado**, com pagamentos fixos durante um prazo que depende do valor emprestado.

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **O Plano de Assistência ao Reembolso (RAP)**, um plano baseado na renda.

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: Sob o RAP, os pagamentos mensais são baseados na renda bruta ajustada, geralmente variando de cerca de 1% a 10% da renda, com um pagamento mínimo de $10 por mês.

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: O pagamento é reduzido para cada filho dependente.

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: Dois recursos são projetados para evitar que os saldos cresçam: se o seu pagamento não cobrir os juros mensais, os juros não pagos não são adicionados, e para cada pagamento pontual, o governo iguala parte da redução do principal (até $50).

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: Os saldos restantes são perdoados após 30 anos de pagamentos qualificáveis.

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. Planos antigos baseados na renda estão sendo eliminados gradualmente

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: Os planos SAVE, PAYE e ICR estão sendo encerrados sob a nova lei, e espera-se que os mutuários neles mudem para outro plano, como o RAP ou o Reembolso Baseado na Renda (IBR), até **1º de julho de 2028**.

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: O SAVE também tem estado envolvido em desafios judiciais, e muitos mutuários do SAVE têm estado em um status de pausa.

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: Se isso descreve você, fique atento aos avisos do seu administrador e não presuma que seu status é permanente.

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. Limites de empréstimos para pós-graduação e profissionais

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: Para novos mutuários em ou após 1º de julho de 2026:

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Tipo de empréstimo | Limite anual | Limite agregado |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Pós-graduação (não profissional) | $20.500 | $100.000 |

segments.src: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Profissional (como medicina ou direito) | $50.000 | $200.000 |

segments.src: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | Limite vitalício em estudos de pós-graduação e profissionais | | $257.500 (exclui empréstimos de graduação) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Os empréstimos Grad PLUS não estão mais disponíveis para novos mutuários.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: Estudantes que precisam de mais do que os limites permitem podem ter que recorrer a economias, bolsas de estudo, auxílio do empregador ou empréstimos privados, que geralmente carecem de proteções federais, como o reembolso baseado na renda.

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. Limites do Parent PLUS

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: O novo empréstimo Parent PLUS é limitado a **$20.000 por ano e $65.000 no total por estudante dependente**.

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: Pais que já possuem empréstimos Parent PLUS, especialmente os consolidados, devem verificar quais opções de reembolso ainda terão.

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: Em geral, certos empréstimos Parent PLUS consolidados devem cumprir prazos específicos de consolidação e inscrição para manter o acesso a uma opção baseada na renda.

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. Menos pausas para novos empréstimos

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: Para empréstimos feitos após 1º de julho de 2027, os adiamentos por dificuldades econômicas e desemprego estão programados para serem removidos.

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: As regras de tolerância (forbearance) também foram endurecidas.

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: Os empréstimos existentes geralmente não são afetados, mas vale a pena confirmar isso para sua situação.

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## O que permanece igual

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **Os empréstimos existentes continuam sendo empréstimos federais.** Ter um empréstimo feito antes de julho de 2026 não o transforma em um novo tipo de empréstimo.

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **O Reembolso Baseado na Renda (IBR) continua disponível.** Ele continua sendo uma opção para muitos mutuários atuais.

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **O Perdão de Empréstimo por Serviço Público (PSLF)** continua a existir. Pagamentos qualificáveis sob planos elegíveis, incluindo o RAP, contam para os 120 pagamentos necessários. As regras de elegibilidade do empregador continuam em destaque, portanto, verifique as definições atuais.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **O reembolso padrão, as taxas de juros em empréstimos existentes e as proteções federais**, como a quitação por morte e invalidez, continuam.

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Os limites de empréstimo de graduação** para empréstimos diretos permanecem praticamente inalterados.

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## Proteções de transição

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: Estudantes que já estavam matriculados em um programa de graduação e haviam recebido um empréstimo federal para ele antes de 1º de julho de 2026 podem conseguir continuar tomando emprestado sob as regras antigas por um período limitado, geralmente até três anos acadêmicos ou a duração esperada do programa, o que for mais curto.

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: Pergunte ao escritório de auxílio financeiro da sua escola se isso se aplica a você.

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## Datas para verificar

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **1º de julho de 2026:** Começam os novos limites de empréstimo, o fim do Grad PLUS para novos mutuários e a disponibilidade do RAP.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **Seus próprios prazos:** A recertificação anual de renda, as janelas de consolidação e as datas de notificação do administrador podem variar de acordo com o mutuário.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## Uma lista de verificação prática

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **Faça login no StudentAid.gov** e confirme seus tipos de empréstimo, saldos, administrador e plano atual.

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **Use o Simulador de Empréstimo oficial** para comparar seus pagamentos estimados sob o RAP, IBR e o plano padrão.

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. **Mantenha suas informações de contato atualizadas** para que você receba os avisos do administrador.

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **Fique atento aos prazos de consolidação** se você possui empréstimos Parent PLUS ou tipos de empréstimos mais antigos.

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **Tenha cuidado com ofertas externas.** A ajuda para empréstimos do governo é gratuita. Empresas que cobram taxas antecipadas ou prometem perdão garantido merecem escrutínio.

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. **Planeje com antecedência para a pós-graduação**, estimando os custos totais em relação aos novos limites bem antes de se inscrever.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: As novas regras simplificam o menu de planos de reembolso, mas alteram as compensações: tetos de empréstimo mais baixos para diplomas avançados e pais, e um único plano principal baseado na renda daqui para frente.

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: A maioria dos mutuários atuais não enfrenta uma mudança imediata, mas o prazo do plano de 2028 e quaisquer avisos do administrador devem estar no seu calendário.

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: O melhor próximo passo é verificar sua conta hoje e comparar suas opções antes que um prazo force a decisão.

in.title: Reset Pinjaman Mahasiswa: Arti Aturan Pembayaran Baru bagi Peminjam Saat Ini

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: Pinjaman mahasiswa federal sedang mengalami perombakan terbesar dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: Undang-undang yang disahkan pada Juli 2025 (biasanya disebut One Big Beautiful Bill Act) mengubah cara pinjaman baru dan yang sudah ada dibayar kembali, serta mengubah jumlah yang dapat dipinjam oleh mahasiswa dan orang tua.

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: Penjelasan ini merangkum poin-poin utama, memisahkan apa yang berubah dari apa yang tetap sama, dan mencantumkan tanggal-tanggal yang perlu diperiksa.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini berisi informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan atau hukum.

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Detail program dapat diperbarui oleh Kongres dan Departemen Pendidikan, jadi pastikan detail spesifiknya di StudentAid.gov atau dengan penyedia layanan pinjaman Anda.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## Versi singkat

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - Opsi berbasis pendapatan yang baru, yaitu **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, menggantikan beberapa rencana lama untuk pinjaman baru yang dibuat pada atau setelah 1 Juli 2026.

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - **Pinjaman Graduate PLUS dihentikan** bagi peminjam baru, dan batas tahunan serta seumur hidup yang baru berlaku untuk pinjaman pascasarjana, profesional, dan Parent PLUS.

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - Banyak peminjam saat ini tetap mempertahankan rencana lama mereka untuk saat ini, tetapi beberapa rencana sedang dihapuskan secara bertahap, dan tenggat waktu berlaku.

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## Apa yang berubah

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. Sistem pembayaran kembali yang baru

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: Mulai 1 Juli 2026, peminjam dengan pinjaman baru dapat memilih di antara dua opsi:

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **Rencana standar bertingkat**, dengan pembayaran tetap selama jangka waktu yang bergantung pada jumlah yang dipinjam.

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, yaitu rencana berbasis pendapatan.

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: Di bawah RAP, pembayaran bulanan didasarkan pada pendapatan kotor yang disesuaikan, umumnya berkisar antara 1% hingga 10% dari pendapatan, dengan pembayaran minimum $10 per bulan.

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: Pembayaran dikurangi untuk setiap anak tanggungan.

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: Dua fitur dirancang agar saldo tidak bertambah: jika pembayaran Anda tidak mencakup bunga bulanan, bunga yang belum dibayar tidak akan ditambahkan, dan untuk setiap pembayaran tepat waktu, pemerintah akan mencocokkan sebagian dari pengurangan pokok (hingga $50).

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: Sisa saldo akan diputihkan setelah 30 tahun pembayaran yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. Rencana berbasis pendapatan yang lebih lama sedang dihapuskan secara bertahap

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: Rencana SAVE, PAYE, dan ICR sedang dihentikan di bawah undang-undang baru, dan peminjam yang menggunakannya diharapkan beralih ke rencana lain, seperti RAP atau Income-Based Repayment (IBR), selambat-lambatnya pada **1 Juli 2028**.

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: SAVE juga telah terjerat dalam tantangan hukum, dan banyak peminjam SAVE berada dalam status ditangguhkan.

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: Jika itu menggambarkan situasi Anda, perhatikan pemberitahuan dari penyedia layanan Anda dan jangan menganggap status Anda permanen.

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. Batas pinjaman pascasarjana dan profesional

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: Bagi peminjam baru pada atau setelah 1 Juli 2026:

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Jenis pinjaman | Batas tahunan | Batas agregat |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Pascasarjana (non-profesional) | $20.500 | $100.000 |

segments.src: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Profesional (seperti kedokteran atau hukum) | $50.000 | $200.000 |

segments.src: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | Batas seumur hidup untuk studi pascasarjana dan profesional | | $257.500 (tidak termasuk pinjaman sarjana) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Pinjaman Grad PLUS tidak lagi tersedia bagi peminjam baru.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: Mahasiswa yang membutuhkan lebih dari batas yang diizinkan mungkin harus beralih ke tabungan, beasiswa, bantuan pemberi kerja, atau pinjaman swasta, yang umumnya tidak memiliki perlindungan federal seperti pembayaran kembali berbasis pendapatan.

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. Batas Parent PLUS

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: Pinjaman Parent PLUS baru dibatasi hingga **$20.000 per tahun dan total $65.000 per mahasiswa tanggungan**.

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: Orang tua yang sudah memiliki pinjaman Parent PLUS, terutama yang telah dikonsolidasikan, harus memeriksa opsi pembayaran mana yang masih akan mereka miliki.

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: Secara umum, pinjaman Parent PLUS yang dikonsolidasikan tertentu harus memenuhi tenggat waktu konsolidasi dan pendaftaran khusus untuk mempertahankan akses ke opsi berbasis pendapatan.

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. Lebih sedikit penundaan untuk pinjaman baru

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: Untuk pinjaman yang dibuat setelah 1 Juli 2027, penundaan kesulitan ekonomi dan pengangguran dijadwalkan untuk dihapus.

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: Aturan keringanan pembayaran juga diperketat.

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: Pinjaman yang sudah ada umumnya tidak terkena dampaknya, tetapi hal itu perlu dikonfirmasi untuk situasi Anda.

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## Apa yang tetap sama

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **Pinjaman yang ada tetap menjadi pinjaman federal.** Memiliki pinjaman yang dibuat sebelum Juli 2026 tidak mengubahnya menjadi jenis pinjaman baru.

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) tetap tersedia.** Ini terus menjadi pilihan bagi banyak peminjam saat ini.

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** terus ada. Pembayaran yang memenuhi syarat di bawah rencana yang memenuhi syarat, termasuk RAP, dihitung sebagai bagian dari 120 pembayaran yang diperlukan. Aturan kelayakan pemberi kerja tetap menjadi sorotan, jadi periksa definisi saat ini.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **Pembayaran standar, suku bunga pada pinjaman yang ada, dan perlindungan federal** seperti pembebasan karena kematian dan disabilitas tetap berlanjut.

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Batas pinjaman sarjana** untuk pinjaman langsung sebagian besar tidak berubah.

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## Perlindungan transisi

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: Mahasiswa yang sudah terdaftar dalam program gelar dan telah menerima pinjaman federal untuk itu sebelum 1 Juli 2026 mungkin dapat terus meminjam di bawah aturan lama untuk jangka waktu terbatas, umumnya hingga tiga tahun akademik atau durasi yang diharapkan dari program tersebut, mana saja yang lebih singkat.

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: Tanyakan kepada kantor bantuan keuangan sekolah Anda apakah ini berlaku untuk Anda.

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## Tanggal untuk diperiksa

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **1 Juli 2026:** Batas pinjaman baru, berakhirnya Grad PLUS untuk peminjam baru, dan ketersediaan RAP dimulai.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **1 Juli 2027:** Perubahan pada opsi penundaan dan keringanan pembayaran untuk pinjaman baru mulai berlaku.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **1 Juli 2028:** Tanggal target bagi peminjam pada SAVE, PAYE, dan ICR untuk beralih ke rencana lain, dan untuk penutupan rencana lama.

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **Tenggat waktu Anda sendiri:** Sertifikasi ulang pendapatan tahunan, jendela konsolidasi, dan tanggal pemberitahuan penyedia layanan dapat berbeda bagi setiap peminjam.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar periksa praktis

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **Masuk ke StudentAid.gov** dan konfirmasikan jenis pinjaman, saldo, penyedia layanan, dan rencana saat ini.

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Periksa rencana yang Anda gunakan** dan apakah rencana tersebut termasuk dalam rencana yang sedang dihapuskan secara bertahap.

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **Gunakan Loan Simulator resmi** untuk membandingkan perkiraan pembayaran Anda di bawah RAP, IBR, dan rencana standar.

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. **Jaga agar informasi kontak Anda tetap terbaru** agar Anda menerima pemberitahuan dari penyedia layanan.

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **Perhatikan tenggat waktu konsolidasi** jika Anda memegang pinjaman Parent PLUS atau jenis pinjaman yang lebih lama.

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **Berhati-hatilah dengan penawaran luar.** Bantuan pinjaman pemerintah gratis. Perusahaan yang mengenakan biaya di muka atau menjanjikan pembebasan yang dijamin perlu diwaspadai.

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. **Rencanakan ke depan untuk sekolah pascasarjana** dengan memperkirakan total biaya terhadap batas baru jauh sebelum Anda mendaftar.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: Aturan baru menyederhanakan menu rencana pembayaran tetapi mengubah pertukaran: batas pinjaman yang lebih rendah untuk gelar lanjutan dan orang tua, serta satu rencana utama berbasis pendapatan ke depannya.

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar peminjam saat ini tidak menghadapi perubahan langsung, tetapi tenggat waktu rencana 2028 dan pemberitahuan penyedia layanan apa pun harus ada di kalender Anda.

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: Langkah selanjutnya yang terbaik adalah memeriksa akun Anda hari ini dan membandingkan opsi Anda sebelum tenggat waktu memaksa keputusan tersebut.

segments.src: ## What is changing

segments.tr: すでに親向けPLUSローン、特に統合ローンを保有している親は、どの返済オプションを引き続き利用できるかを確認する必要があります。

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: 一般に、特定の統合された親向けPLUSローンは、所得連動型オプションへのアクセスを維持するために、特定の統合および登録期限を満たす必要があります。

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. 新規ローンの猶予措置の減少

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: 2027年7月1日以降に実行されるローンについては、経済的困難および失業による猶予措置が削除される予定です。

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: 差し押さえ猶予（フォーベランス）のルールも厳格化されます。

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: 既存のローンは原則として影響を受けませんが、ご自身の状況について確認する価値があります。

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## 変わらない点

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **既存のローンは連邦ローンのままです。** 2026年7月前に実行されたローンがあるからといって、それが新しいタイプのローンに変わるわけではありません。

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **所得連動型返済（IBR）は引き続き利用可能です。** 現在の多くの借り手にとって引き続きオプションとなります。

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **公共サービスローン免除（PSLF）**は存続します。RAPを含む適格プランの下での適格な支払いは、必要な120回の支払いにカウントされます。雇用主の適格性ルールが引き続き注目されているため、現在の定義を確認してください。

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **標準返済、既存ローンの金利、および死亡や障害による免除**などの連邦政府の保護は継続されます。

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - ダイレクトローンの**学部生の借入限度額**は概ね変更ありません。

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## 移行期の保護措置

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: 2026年7月1日より前にすでに学位プログラムに登録し、それに対して連邦ローンを受給していた学生は、限定された期間（通常は最長3学年度、またはプログラムの想定期間のいずれか短い方）の間、古いルールのもとで借入を継続できる場合があります。

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: これがあなたに当てはまるかどうか、学校の財務支援オフィスにお問い合わせください。

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## 確認すべき日付

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **2026年7月1日：** 新しいローンの限度額、新規借り手向けのGrad PLUSの終了、およびRAPの利用開始。

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **2027年7月1日：** 新規ローンに対する猶予およびフォーベランスオプションの変更が発効。

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **2028年7月1日：** SAVE、PAYE、ICRを利用している借り手が別のプランに移行し、古いプランが終了するための目標日。

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **ご自身の期限：** 年次所得再認証、統合の窓口期間、およびサービサーの通知日は借り手によって異なる場合があります。

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## 実践的なチェックリスト

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **StudentAid.govにログイン**し、ローンタイプ、残高、サービサー、現在のプランを確認します。

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **自分がどのプランを利用しているか**を確認し、それが段階的に廃止される対象に含まれているかどうかを確認します。

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **公式のローンシミュレーターを使用して**、RAP、IBR、標準プランでの推定支払額を比較します。

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. サービサーからの通知を受け取れるように、**連絡先情報を最新の状態に保ちます**。

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. 親向けPLUSローンや古いタイプのローンをお持ちの場合は、**統合の期限に注意してください**。

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **外部からのオファーには注意してください。** 政府のローン支援は無料です。前払手数料を請求したり、免除を保証したりする企業には精査が必要です。

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. 出願するかなり前に、新しい限度額に対する総コストを見積もることで、**大学院に向けて事前に計画を立てましょう**。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: 新しいルールは返済プランのメニューを簡素化しますが、トレードオフを変更します：高度な学位や親に対する借入上限の引き下げ、そして今後は単一の主要な所得連動型プランとなります。

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: 現在のほとんどの借り手は差し迫った変更に直面していませんが、2028年のプランの期限やサービサーからの通知をカレンダーに入れておくべきです。

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: 最善の次のステップは、期限が決定を迫る前に、今日アカウントを確認し、オプションを比較することです。

de.title: Der Neustart bei Studienkrediten: Was die neuen Rückzahlungsregeln für heutige Kreditnehmer bedeuten

segments.src: Federal student loans are in the middle of their biggest overhaul in years.
segments.tr: Staatliche Studienkredite befinden sich mitten in ihrer größten Umstrukturierung seit Jahren.

segments.src: Legislation signed in July 2025 (commonly called the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) changes how new and existing loans are repaid, and it changes how much students and parents can borrow.
segments.tr: Die im Juli 2025 unterzeichnete Gesetzgebung (allgemein als One Big Beautiful Bill Act bezeichnet) ändert die Art und Weise, wie neue und bestehende Kredite zurückgezahlt werden, und sie ändert, wie viel Studenten und Eltern leihen können.

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
segments.tr: Diese Erläuterung fasst die wichtigsten Punkte zusammen, trennt das, was sich ändert, von dem, was gleich bleibt, und listet die Daten auf, die man prüfen sollte.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient der allgemeinen Information, nicht als Finanz- oder Rechtsberatung.

segments.src: Program details can be updated by Congress and the Department of Education, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your loan servicer.*
segments.tr: Programmdetails können vom Kongress und dem Bildungsministerium aktualisiert werden, daher bestätigen Sie Einzelheiten auf StudentAid.gov oder bei Ihrem Kreditdienstleister.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## Die Kurzfassung

segments.src: - A new income-driven option, the **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, replaces several older plans for new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: - Eine neue einkommensabhängige Option, der **Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, ersetzt mehrere ältere Pläne für neue Kredite, die am oder nach dem 1. Juli 2026 aufgenommen wurden.

segments.src: - **Graduate PLUS loans end** for new borrowers, and new annual and lifetime limits apply to graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans.
segments.tr: - **Graduate PLUS-Kredite enden** für neue Kreditnehmer, und neue jährliche sowie lebenslange Obergrenzen gelten für Graduate-, Professional- und Parent PLUS-Kredite.

segments.src: - Many current borrowers keep their existing plans for now, but some plans are being phased out, and deadlines apply.
segments.tr: - Viele aktuelle Kreditnehmer behalten ihre bestehenden Pläne vorerst bei, aber einige Pläne werden schrittweise eingestellt, und es gelten Fristen.

segments.src: ## What is changing
segments.tr: ## Was sich ändert

segments.src: ### 1. A new repayment system
segments.tr: ### 1. Ein neues Rückzahlungssystem

segments.src: Starting July 1, 2026, borrowers with new loans choose between two options:
segments.tr: Ab dem 1. Juli 2026 wählen Kreditnehmer mit neuen Krediten zwischen zwei Optionen:

segments.src: - **A tiered standard plan**, with fixed payments over a term that depends on the amount borrowed.
segments.tr: - **Ein gestaffelter Standardplan**, mit festen Zahlungen über eine Laufzeit, die von der geliehenen Summe abhängt.

segments.src: - **The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, an income-based plan.
segments.tr: - **Der Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)**, ein einkommensbasierter Plan.

segments.src: Under RAP, monthly payments are based on adjusted gross income, generally ranging from about 1% to 10% of income, with a minimum payment of $10 per month.
segments.tr: Im Rahmen des RAP basieren die monatlichen Zahlungen auf dem bereinigten Bruttoeinkommen, das im Allgemeinen zwischen etwa 1 % und 10 % des Einkommens liegt, mit einer Mindestzahlung von $10 pro Monat.

segments.src: The payment is reduced for each dependent child.
segments.tr: Die Zahlung wird für jedes unterhaltsberechtigte Kind reduziert.

segments.src: Two features are designed to keep balances from growing: if your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is not added on, and for each on-time payment the government matches part of the principal reduction (up to $50).
segments.tr: Zwei Funktionen sollen verhindern, dass die Salden wachsen: Wenn Ihre Zahlung die monatlichen Zinsen nicht deckt, werden die unbezahlten Zinsen nicht addiert, und für jede pünktliche Zahlung gleicht die Regierung einen Teil der Tilgung aus (bis zu $50).

segments.src: Remaining balances are forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: Verbleibende Salden werden nach 30 Jahren qualifizierender Zahlungen erlassen.

segments.src: ### 2. Older income-driven plans are being phased out
segments.tr: ### 2. Ältere einkommensabhängige Pläne werden schrittweise eingestellt

segments.src: The SAVE, PAYE and ICR plans are being wound down under the new law, and borrowers on them are expected to move to another plan, such as RAP or Income-Based Repayment (IBR), by **July 1, 2028**.
segments.tr: Die SAVE-, PAYE- und ICR-Pläne werden gemäß dem neuen Gesetz auslaufen, und von den Kreditnehmern, die diese nutzen, wird erwartet, dass sie bis zum **1. Juli 2028** zu einem anderen Plan wechseln, wie z. B. RAP oder Income-Based Repayment (IBR).

segments.src: SAVE has also been tied up in court challenges, and many SAVE borrowers have been in a paused status.
segments.tr: SAVE war auch in gerichtliche Auseinandersetzungen verwickelt, und viele SAVE-Kreditnehmer befanden sich in einem pausierten Status.

segments.src: If that describes you, watch for notices from your servicer and don't assume your status is permanent.
segments.tr: Wenn das auf Sie zutrifft, achten Sie auf Mitteilungen Ihres Dienstleisters und gehen Sie nicht davon aus, dass Ihr Status dauerhaft ist.

segments.src: ### 3. Graduate and professional borrowing caps
segments.tr: ### 3. Kredit-Obergrenzen für Graduate- und Professional-Studien

segments.src: For new borrowers on or after July 1, 2026:
segments.tr: Für neue Kreditnehmer ab dem 1. Juli 2026:

segments.src: | Loan type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Kreditart | Jährliches Limit | Gesamtlimit |

segments.src: | Graduate (non-professional) | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Graduate (nicht-beruflich) | $20,500 | $100,000 |

segments.src: | Professional (such as medicine or law) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Professional (z. B. Medizin oder Jura) | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Lifetime cap across graduate and professional study | | $257,500 (excludes undergraduate loans) |
segments.tr: | Lebenslange Obergrenze für Graduate- und Professional-Studien | | $257,500 (exklusive Undergraduate-Kredite) |

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Grad PLUS-Kredite sind für neue Kreditnehmer nicht mehr verfügbar.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may have to turn to savings, scholarships, employer aid, or private loans, which generally lack federal protections such as income-driven repayment.
segments.tr: Studenten, die mehr benötigen, als die Obergrenzen erlauben, müssen möglicherweise auf Ersparnisse, Stipendien, Arbeitgeberhilfe oder Privatkredite zurückgreifen, denen im Allgemeinen staatliche Schutzmaßnahmen wie die einkommensabhängige Rückzahlung fehlen.

segments.src: ### 4. Parent PLUS limits
segments.tr: ### 4. Parent PLUS-Limits

segments.src: New Parent PLUS borrowing is capped at **$20,000 per year and $65,000 total per dependent student**.
segments.tr: Neue Parent PLUS-Kredite sind auf **$20,000 pro Jahr und $65,000 insgesamt pro unterhaltsberechtigtem Studenten** begrenzt.

segments.src: Parents who already hold Parent PLUS loans, especially consolidated ones, should check which repayment options they will still have.
segments.tr: Eltern, die bereits Parent PLUS-Kredite halten, insbesondere konsolidierte, sollten prüfen, welche Rückzahlungsoptionen sie noch haben werden.

segments.src: In general, certain consolidated Parent PLUS loans must meet specific consolidation and enrollment deadlines to keep access to an income-driven option.
segments.tr: Im Allgemeinen müssen bestimmte konsolidierte Parent PLUS-Kredite spezifische Konsolidierungs- und Anmeldefristen einhalten, um den Zugang zu einer einkommensabhängigen Option zu behalten.

segments.src: ### 5. Fewer pauses for new loans
segments.tr: ### 5. Weniger Pausen für neue Kredite

segments.src: For loans made after July 1, 2027, the economic hardship and unemployment deferments are scheduled to be removed.
segments.tr: Für Kredite, die nach dem 1. Juli 2027 aufgenommen wurden, sollen die Stundungen wegen wirtschaftlicher Notlage und Arbeitslosigkeit gestrichen werden.

segments.src: Forbearance rules are also tightened.
segments.tr: Die Regeln für die Stundung (Forbearance) werden ebenfalls verschärft.

segments.src: Existing loans are generally not affected, but that is worth confirming for your situation.
segments.tr: Bestehende Kredite sind im Allgemeinen nicht betroffen, aber das sollte für Ihre Situation überprüft werden.

segments.src: ## What stays the same
segments.tr: ## Was gleich bleibt

segments.src: - **Existing loans remain federal loans.** Having a loan made before July 2026 does not turn it into a new type of loan.
segments.tr: - **Bestehende Kredite bleiben staatliche Kredite.** Ein Kredit, der vor Juli 2026 aufgenommen wurde, wird nicht zu einer neuen Kreditart.

segments.src: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) remains available.** It continues to be an option for many current borrowers.
segments.tr: - **Income-Based Repayment (IBR) bleibt verfügbar.** Es ist weiterhin eine Option für viele aktuelle Kreditnehmer.

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** continues to exist. Qualifying payments under eligible plans, including RAP, count toward the 120 required payments. Employer eligibility rules remain in the spotlight, so check the current definitions.
segments.tr: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)** existiert weiterhin. Qualifizierende Zahlungen im Rahmen berechtigter Pläne, einschließlich RAP, zählen zu den 120 erforderlichen Zahlungen. Die Regeln zur Arbeitgeberberechtigung stehen weiterhin im Fokus, prüfen Sie also die aktuellen Definitionen.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment, interest rates on existing loans and federal protections** such as death and disability discharge continue.
segments.tr: - **Standardrückzahlung, Zinssätze für bestehende Kredite und staatliche Schutzmaßnahmen** wie der Erlass bei Tod und Invalidität bleiben bestehen.

segments.src: - **Undergraduate borrowing limits** for direct loans are largely unchanged.
segments.tr: - **Undergraduate-Kreditlimits** für direkte Kredite sind weitgehend unverändert.

segments.src: ## Transition protections
segments.tr: ## Übergangsschutz

segments.src: Students who were already enrolled in a degree program and had received a federal loan for it before July 1, 2026 may be able to keep borrowing under the older rules for a limited period, generally up to three academic years or the expected length of the program, whichever is shorter.
segments.tr: Studenten, die bereits in einem Studiengang eingeschrieben waren und vor dem 1. Juli 2026 einen staatlichen Kredit dafür erhalten hatten, können möglicherweise für einen begrenzten Zeitraum weiterhin nach den alten Regeln Kredite aufnehmen, im Allgemeinen bis zu drei akademische Jahre oder die erwartete Dauer des Programms, je nachdem, was kürzer ist.

segments.src: Ask your school's financial aid office whether this applies to you.
segments.tr: Fragen Sie das Finanzhilfebüro Ihrer Hochschule, ob dies auf Sie zutrifft.

segments.src: ## Dates to check
segments.tr: ## Zu prüfende Daten

segments.src: - **July 1, 2026:** New loan limits, the end of Grad PLUS for new borrowers, and RAP availability begin.
segments.tr: - **1. Juli 2026:** Neue Kreditlimits, das Ende von Grad PLUS für neue Kreditnehmer und die Verfügbarkeit von RAP beginnen.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2027:** Changes to deferment and forbearance options for new loans take effect.
segments.tr: - **1. Juli 2027:** Änderungen an den Stundungs- und Forbearance-Optionen für neue Kredite treten in Kraft.

segments.src: - **July 1, 2028:** Target date for borrowers on SAVE, PAYE and ICR to move to another plan, and for the older plans to close.
segments.tr: - **1. Juli 2028:** Zieldatum für Kreditnehmer in SAVE, PAYE und ICR, um zu einem anderen Plan zu wechseln, und für das Auslaufen der älteren Pläne.

segments.src: - **Your own deadlines:** Annual income recertification, consolidation windows and servicer notice dates can differ by borrower.
segments.tr: - **Ihre eigenen Fristen:** Jährliche Einkommensneuzertifizierung, Konsolidierungsfenster und Termine für Mitteilungen des Dienstleisters können je nach Kreditnehmer variieren.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist
segments.tr: ## Eine praktische Checkliste

segments.src: 1. **Log in to StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances, servicer and current plan.
segments.tr: 1. **Melden Sie sich bei StudentAid.gov an** und bestätigen Sie Ihre Kreditarten, Salden, Dienstleister und den aktuellen Plan.

segments.src: 2. **Check which plan you are on** and whether it is among those being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Prüfen Sie, in welchem Plan Sie sind** und ob er zu denen gehört, die schrittweise eingestellt werden.

segments.src: 3. **Use the official Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated payments under RAP, IBR and the standard plan.
segments.tr: 3. **Nutzen Sie den offiziellen Loan Simulator**, um Ihre geschätzten Zahlungen unter RAP, IBR und dem Standardplan zu vergleichen.

segments.src: 4. **Keep your contact information current** so you receive servicer notices.
segments.tr: 4. **Halten Sie Ihre Kontaktinformationen aktuell**, damit Sie Mitteilungen des Dienstleisters erhalten.

segments.src: 5. **Watch for consolidation deadlines** if you hold Parent PLUS loans or older loan types.
segments.tr: 5. **Achten Sie auf Konsolidierungsfristen**, wenn Sie Parent PLUS-Kredite oder ältere Kreditarten halten.

segments.src: 6. **Be careful with outside offers.** Government loan help is free. Companies that charge up-front fees or promise guaranteed forgiveness deserve scrutiny.
segments.tr: 6. **Seien Sie vorsichtig bei externen Angeboten.** Staatliche Kredithilfe ist kostenlos. Unternehmen, die Vorauszahlungen verlangen oder einen garantierten Erlass versprechen, sollten kritisch hinterfragt werden.

segments.src: 7. **Plan ahead for graduate school** by estimating total costs against the new caps well before you apply.
segments.tr: 7. **Planen Sie für das Graduate-Studium voraus**, indem Sie die Gesamtkosten im Vergleich zu den neuen Obergrenzen lange vor der Bewerbung schätzen.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: The new rules simplify the menu of repayment plans but change the tradeoffs: lower borrowing ceilings for advanced degrees and parents, and a single main income-based plan going forward.
segments.tr: Die neuen Regeln vereinfachen das Menü der Rückzahlungspläne, ändern aber die Kompromisse: niedrigere Kreditobergrenzen für fortgeschrittene Abschlüsse und Eltern sowie ein einziger Haupteinkommensplan für die Zukunft.

segments.src: Most current borrowers aren't facing an immediate change, but the 2028 plan deadline and any servicer notices should be on your calendar.
segments.tr: Die meisten aktuellen Kreditnehmer stehen nicht vor einer unmittelbaren Änderung, aber die Planfrist 2028 und alle Mitteilungen des Dienstleisters sollten in Ihrem Kalender stehen.

segments.src: The best next step is to check your account today and compare your options before a deadline forces the decision.
segments.tr: Der beste nächste Schritt ist, heute Ihr Konto zu überprüfen und Ihre Optionen zu vergleichen, bevor eine Frist die Entscheidung erzwingt.

segments.src: This explainer summarizes the main points, separates what changes from what stays the same, and lists the dates worth checking.
